name: read-range-clamp
source: real change in the muellim repository: Task 11 review fix to src/engine/context.ts, readFile clamps the line range

question.topic: negative end line in a lookup
question.prompt: The AI calls readFile on a tracked 1,000-line file with fromLine 50 and toLine -1. How many lines come back now, and what did the old const to = Math.min(...) line return for the same call?
question.answerKey: None: to is clamped to at least from - 1, which is 49, so slice(49, 49) is empty. Before, to was -1, and slice(49, -1) counts from the end, so it returned everything from line 50 to the end of the file but one line, about 950 lines, far past the 200-line cap.
rubric: the call now returns no lines because to is clamped to at least from - 1
the old code passed a negative end to slice, which counts from the end and returned hundreds of lines past the 200-line cap

answers.text: Zero lines. to becomes max(from - 1, -1) = 49 so the slice is empty. The old code did slice(49, -1), and a negative end means "from the end", so it returned about 950 lines and went way over the 200-line cap.
empty result now. before: negative toLine, slice counted from the end, so almost the whole file from line 50 came back, way over READ_LINE_CAP
It throws a RangeError for the negative line number.
